specials.title: Specials for the Week of February 18th
specials.description:
Soup: Italian Chicken Soup (available in a cup or bowl)

Appetizers: 

Mini Bean & Cheese Quesadillas with Pico de Gallo and Sour Cream

Eggplant Rounds with Ricotta & Marinara Sauce

Entrees:

Red Dog Chicken Pot Pie 

Crown Club Marinated Steaks (Ribeye $38 or Filet Mignon $42*) with Baked Potato and Choice of Side

(*So far filet's are still out of stock- we are hoping to have filets available again by Friday)

Lunch Specials:
Sundried Tomato, Spinach and Ricotta Grilled Cheese 
(Add chicken and/or soup!)

Mixed Green Italian Salad: mixed greens, marinated red onions, pepperoncini, flaked parmesan

Dessert: Strawberry Cheesecake (Gluten Free!) $10
